Himmat bina takraar ke discipline hai.
Grit teevra hai.
Bahadur hona: afraid hoke bhi move.
Himmat kuch nahi maangti.
Jitni sakht jung, utni meethi jeet.
Discipline abhi jo chahiye aur jo sabse zyada chahiye ke beech.
Grit hope + effort hai.
Grit ka matlab apne kal ke liye tike rehna.
Grit matlab lagatar peecha karna hai.
Tum jo karte ho, itna loud bolta hai ki main tumhare kehne ko sun hi nahi pata.
Dhairya kadwa hota hai, lekin iska phal meetha hota hai.
Khamoshi ek gehra jawab hai.
Himmat unchi hai.
Fear ke presence mein action—courage.
Chuppi gyaan ki jad hai.
Sahas sabse zaroori gun hai; bina iske koi bhi dusra gun lagataar nahi nibhaya ja sakta.
Grit ka matlab hai raaste par tikna.
Safal vyakti aur dusron ka farq taakat nahi, ichcha ki kami hai.
